dialogues.speaker: Gacic
dialogues.text: The instructions were clear, and the message you received should be the same as mine.

dialogues.speaker: Ciment
dialogues.text: What were the orders you received? Let's double-check.

dialogues.speaker: Gacic
dialogues.text: I don't want trouble. We'll each follow the instructions, do the job, and then leave with the Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Ciment
dialogues.text: Is your superior out at sea, or landside?

dialogues.speaker: Gacic
dialogues.text: What did I just say? No chit-chat. I don't want to end up sleeping with the fishes.

dialogues.speaker: Ciment
dialogues.text: Please. For all I know, your orders might be to slap some cement shoes on me and toss me in the harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Gacic
dialogues.text: If you stop asking questions, you won't have anything to worry about.
